## MKV Track Organizer 1.0.25

This release starts the Organizer Queue v2 workflow.

### Changed

- The Organizer queue button is now "Add preview" and stays disabled until a successful Preview exists.
- Queued Organizer jobs now snapshot the current preview plan, including manual track include/exclude edits and manual drag order.
- Running an Organizer queue job no longer depends on later UI changes to the active Organizer settings.

### Added

- Added optional "Auto drop duplicates" and "Auto drop probable" Organizer settings.
- Added matching profile/config support and CLI flags:
  - `--auto-drop-duplicates`
  - `--auto-drop-probable-duplicates`

### Notes

- Manual Preview cleanup still works: run Preview, drop duplicates/probables or adjust tracks manually, then click Add preview.
- The new auto-drop options are off by default.
